notes.title: Game release date announced!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With the latest trailer, the release date for Deathdays End has finally been unveiled! 
I am pleased to announce that the game will be releasing on 26th December 2018.

A bit late to the party I know, but follow me on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/JoeySlynt]@JoeySlynt[/url] to stay tuned for further updates.

Happy holidays in advance!

Joey Slynt,
Anonymous Games
